visualReview.notes: Detached Triclinium conservation shelter: exact mapped triapsidal footprint, pale central hipped roof/three radial apse caps, raised roof ribs and perimeter frame posts, low stone ruin base and opaque glazing proxies. Real west0.7m door recess with closed soffit/threshold and three short exterior treads. Two ordinary aerials, one inspected again this round, plus standard PMTiles/Mapzen guide the exterior. Revised the eastern detail camera after the first north view was inside a procedural context neighbor. No copied mosaics or furnished rooms. Combined native view loads this model and the already completed main complex together; Xystus/gate/latrines remain procedural pending unique models.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Five material roles share four existing256px graphs: stone_limestone_raw, glass_frit_triangular (roof/window slots with pale/cool tint variants), metal_painted and tile_mosaic. Canonical metric UV repeats and sRGB-to-linear vertex tint; baked graph means retain skyline tone. Pale opaque glazing/roof is a low-cost proxy for the photographed translucent shelter, without literal refraction or a copied image. No embedded images, private atlas or new graph. Five textured draws/one skyline; separate vertex streams and equal CPU/GPU bytes. Each graph reads once. The two-model native scene shares eight total graphs; each reads once.
